small.mem_method: fresh worker RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss delta (Metal child high-water RSS)

medium.mem_method: fresh worker RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss delta (Metal child high-water RSS)

large.mem_method: fresh worker RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss delta (Metal child high-water RSS)

notes: Wall times include output materialization and, for Metal, binary launch and file I/O. Each warmup and repeat uses a fresh Python process; startup is outside the timer. Memory values are medians of three peaks, in MiB. Metal child ru_maxrss is a high-water mark, not GPU allocation alone. MLX RSS is a process high-water mark. Relative difference is max absolute error divided by reference peak amplitude. Inputs use seed 1201, dx=5 m, c=1500 m/s and Courant number 0.5.
